highlights: Hidden agents now keep working. Turn on again the routines of the agents that you hid before this version.
A message that you send to a working agent now steers its turn. You can still select Queue in Settings > Agents.
Pin messages in a chat, and sort your Library files into folders.
Teach an agent a task in its browser, and add skills from a GitHub link.
Pool the accounts of a provider, and export a full copy of a server or copy its agents to another server.
